$comment: Where three.ws runs inside Microsoft products, rendered by /microsoft (src/microsoft-hub.js). status is one of: live, pending review, built, awaiting publish. Change a status only with evidence (a public listing URL for live, a submission receipt for pending review). tests/microsoft-surfaces.test.js validates the shape.

surfaces.name: Microsoft Marketplace
surfaces.today: Find three.ws on Microsoft Marketplace through the publisher profile. Buying a plan inside Marketplace with your Microsoft account switches on when the transactable SaaS offer is published; until then plans are bought on three.ws.
surfaces.built: Purchase landing page, Entra sign-in, the fulfilment webhook and hourly metered billing. A Microsoft subscription grants the same plan as a card purchase.

surfaces.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
surfaces.today: Open the Teams tab in any browser to search every public agent and meet one in live 3D. The app itself is not in the Teams store yet.
surfaces.built: A declarative Copilot agent wired to the three.ws MCP server, a Teams bot for chats and channels, and the Teams tab.

surfaces.name: Power Platform
surfaces.today: Not in the connector gallery yet. Makers can import the OpenAPI definition from the repository as a custom connector in Power Automate or Power Apps.
surfaces.built: Five actions for Power Automate, Power Apps, Logic Apps and Copilot Studio, with OAuth and PKCE.

surfaces.name: Microsoft Store
surfaces.today: Not in the Microsoft Store yet. three.ws is an installable web app, so Edge can install it on Windows today from the address bar's app install button.
surfaces.built: The installable web app packaged as MSIX through PWABuilder, with the Store listing copy drafted.

surfaces.name: Edge Add-ons
surfaces.today: Not on Edge Add-ons yet. Developers can build Walk Avatar and Checkout Companion from the repository and load them unpacked in Edge.
surfaces.built: Two Manifest V3 extensions reviewed against Edge's package rules, zipped by one command.

surfaces.name: Visual Studio Code
surfaces.today: Install three.ws x402 from the Visual Studio Marketplace. The 3D extension with the @threews chat participant is built and tested, and not published yet.
surfaces.built: threews.vscode-x402 is published. vscode-3d passes its test suite and packages cleanly.

surfaces.name: Copilot Studio and Foundry
surfaces.today: Add the server URL below as a custom MCP server in Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry today. No key needed. The certified Microsoft listing is not submitted yet.
surfaces.built: A keyless streamable HTTP MCP server for 3D generation, rigging, the asset catalog and agent personas.
